what: a closed periodic fit-point spline through 6 points, extruded 10
method: a periodic fit spline is the cyclic C2 cubic through its points with chord-length knots (crates/sketch/src/periodic.rs); A = 1/2 loop int (x y' - y x') over its six spans (Gauss, exact on the polynomials) = 1228.101202178, its length L by Gauss = 124.240003044; V = 10 A, area 2 A + 10 L. Faces: one side face per span + the caps; edges 6 + 6 + 6 vertical; vertices 12. The points are symmetric about both axes, so the curve is: x reaches 20 at (+-20, 0) (vertical tangent there), y reaches 19.600203460 between (10, 17) and (-10, 17); centre of mass (0, 0, 5)
